name: Someya Shiiko
source: A 10-year-old 5th grade elementary school girl. The protagonist's cute girlfriend and lover. She's the class representative in her school. She's shy and blushes easily but she loves the protagonist! In Shiiko Love it's her birthday soon, and she'll soon be 11!
